ja: この薬は眠くなるか、伺いたいのですが。
en: I was wondering if this medicine makes you drowsy.
alternatives: I was wondering whether this medicine causes drowsiness.
Could you tell me whether this medicine causes drowsiness?
point: was wondering で丁寧に。中身は if 節

ja: 薬の服用中、お酒は控えるべきですか？
en: Should I avoid alcohol on this medicine?
alternatives: Should I avoid drinking while taking this medicine?
Should I avoid alcohol while taking this?
point: 「服用中」は on this medicine と短く言える（avoid の後は名詞か -ing）

ja: 先週もらった薬が効かないんです。
en: The medicine from last week isn't working.
alternatives: The medicine I got last week doesn't work.
Last week's medicine isn't working.
point: 「先週の薬」は from last week で名詞を後ろから説明

ja: 心配なのは頭痛じゃなく、毎朝のめまいなんです。
en: What worries me isn't the headache, it's the morning dizziness.
alternatives: It's not the headache that worries me, it's the morning dizziness.
It's the dizziness every morning that worries me, not the headache.
point: 「心配なのは〜」は What worries me is で強調する

ja: かかりつけ医が週末も診てくれたらいいのに。
en: I wish our family doctor saw patients on weekends.
alternatives: If only our family doctor were open on weekends.
I wish our family doctor worked weekends.
point: 今の願望は wish + 過去形

ja: 母は、自分が頭を打ったか覚えていません。
en: Mom can't remember if she hit her head.
alternatives: Mom doesn't remember if she hit her head.
Mom can't recall whether she hit her head.
point: 「〜かどうか」は if / whether。節の中は平叙文の語順

ja: 熱を下げてくれたのは、この薬なんです。
en: This medicine is what brought my fever down.
alternatives: It was this medicine that brought my fever down.
What brought my fever down was this medicine.
point: 「熱を下げる」は bring 〜 down の句動詞

ja: 熱があるなら、休んでね。
en: Rest if you have a fever.
alternatives: If you have a fever, rest.
Rest if you've got a fever.
point: 「熱がある」は have a fever、a を忘れずに

ja: 息子は熱が出ただけじゃなく、吐きもしたんです。
en: Not only did my son have a fever, he vomited.
alternatives: My son not only had a fever, he also threw up.
My son didn't just have a fever, he threw up too.
point: Not only が文頭なら did my son have の語順

ja: 近くに薬局はありますか？
en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
alternatives: Is there a drugstore nearby?
Is there a pharmacy nearby?
point: 「ありますか」は Is there ～? で聞く

ja: 薬剤師さんによると、胃薬は抗生物質を弱めるかも。
en: The pharmacist said my stomach medicine might weaken the antibiotics.
alternatives: The pharmacist said my stomach pills might weaken the antibiotics.
The pharmacist warned my stomach medicine could weaken the antibiotics.
point: said の後は時制を一つ下げて might にする

ja: 症状が出た時期が、正確に思い出せません。
en: I can't remember exactly when the symptoms started.
alternatives: I can't recall exactly when my symptoms began.
I don't remember exactly when the symptoms began.
point: when 以下は疑問文の語順にしない

ja: 痛み止めが切れると、また熱が上がってきました。
en: My fever spiked again when the painkiller wore off.
alternatives: My fever came back once the painkiller wore off.
The painkiller wore off, and my fever came back.
point: 「切れる」は wear off。効き目が消える時の句動詞

ja: 病院に行くのを先延ばしにしたのが間違いでした。
en: Putting off going to the doctor was a mistake.
alternatives: Postponing my doctor visit was a mistake.
It was a mistake to put off seeing a doctor.
point: put off の後ろは動名詞。to 不定詞は不可

ja: この薬で副作用が出たことはありますか？
en: Have you ever had side effects from this?
alternatives: Has this medicine ever given you side effects?
Have you had any side effects from this?
point: 経験を聞くので Have you ever had、「〜で」は from

ja: 2日前からずっと咳が止まらないんです。
en: I've been coughing nonstop for two days.
alternatives: I've been coughing for two days straight.
My cough hasn't stopped in two days.
I've had this cough for two days.
point: 今も続いている症状は I've been ＋ -ing ＋ for で言う

ja: 先生にアレルギーを伝えておけばよかった。
en: I wish I'd told the doctor about my allergy.
alternatives: If only I'd mentioned my allergy to the doctor.
I should have told the doctor about my allergy.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish の後を過去完了にする

ja: あの荷物、持たなきゃよかった。腰が悲鳴を上げてる。
en: I shouldn't have lifted that. My back is killing me.
alternatives: I wish I hadn't carried that. My back's killing me.
I never should've lifted that. My back is killing me.
point: 後悔は shouldn't have + 過去分詞。痛みは is killing me

ja: この検査の前は、絶食するように言われてるんです。
en: I've been told to fast before this test.
alternatives: I was told not to eat anything before this test.
They told me to fast before this test.
point: 「言われている」は現在完了の受動態 have been told

ja: 私なら、その頭痛は放っておかないけどね。
en: If I were you, I wouldn't let that headache slide.
alternatives: If I were you, I wouldn't ignore that headache.
I wouldn't brush off that headache if I were you.
point: 現在の仮定は if 節が were、主節は would

ja: 先生、咳が出るんです。
en: I have a cough.
alternatives: I've got a cough.
Doctor, I have a cough.
point: 咳は a cough と数えられる名詞で表す

ja: 彼、健診を受けてたら今ごろ入院してないのに。
en: If he'd had a checkup, he wouldn't be hospitalized now.
alternatives: If he'd gotten a checkup, he wouldn't be hospitalized now.
He wouldn't be hospitalized now if he'd had a checkup.
point: 過去の仮定は had+過去分詞、今の結果は wouldn't be

ja: 着いた頃には、もう熱は下がっていました。
en: My fever had gone down when I arrived.
alternatives: My fever had already broken when I arrived.
When I arrived, my fever had already gone.
point: 着いた時点より前に下がったので had gone down と過去完了

ja: 私があなたなら、その咳はすぐ診てもらいますよ。
en: If I were you, I'd get that cough checked now.
alternatives: If I were you, I'd have that cough checked now.
I'd get that cough looked at right away.
I'd get that cough checked now if I were you.
point: 仮定は If I were you。診てもらうは get ~ checked

ja: 夫には明日、絶対に検査を受けさせます。
en: I'm definitely making my husband get checked out tomorrow.
alternatives: I'll definitely make my husband get checked out tomorrow.
I'm definitely getting my husband checked out tomorrow.
point: 嫌がる相手に無理にさせるのは make 人 do。「診てもらう」は get checked out

ja: 先生に、一日安静って言われた。
en: The doctor said to rest for a day.
alternatives: My doctor said I should rest for a day.
The doctor told me to rest for a day.
point: 「言われた」の指示は said to ＋動詞の原形（told me to も可）

ja: 母が転んで、手首を押さえたまま動けなかった。
en: My mom fell and couldn't move, holding her wrist.
alternatives: My mother fell and couldn't move, clutching her wrist.
My mom fell, clutching her wrist, unable to move.
point: 「押さえたまま」は文末に holding を添える

ja: 熱のある人は、どこで待てばいいですか？
en: Where should people with a fever wait?
alternatives: Where should people who have a fever wait?
Where should people running a fever wait?
point: 「熱のある人」は people with a fever と後ろから修飾

ja: 唾を飲み込むだけで喉が痛いんです。
en: Just swallowing hurts my throat.
alternatives: It hurts my throat even to swallow.
My throat hurts every time I swallow.
point: 動名詞は主語になれる。Swallowing hurts〜

ja: 妹は熱があるのに、試験を受けると言い張ってる。
en: Despite her fever, my sister insists on taking the exam.
alternatives: My sister insists on taking the exam despite her fever.
My sister's feverish but insists on taking the exam.
point: insist は on + 動名詞、「のに」は Despite で前に出す

ja: なんだか風邪をひきかけてる気がするんです。
en: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
alternatives: I feel like I'm coming down with a cold.
I think I'm catching a cold.
point: 「ひきかけ」は come down with。catch より口語的

ja: ほかの薬は飲んでいますか？
en: Are you taking any other medicine?
alternatives: Are you on any other medicine?
Are you taking any other medication?
point: 薬を「飲む」は drink ではなく take

ja: 夜食を食べるのはやめました。
en: I stopped eating late-night snacks.
alternatives: I quit eating late-night snacks.
I gave up late-night snacks.
point: stop の後ろの「〜するのをやめる」は動名詞 (eating)

ja: これは今までで一番ひどい腰痛です。
en: This is the worst back pain I've ever had.
alternatives: I've never had back pain this bad.
My back pain is the worst I've ever had.
point: 最上級のあとは I've ever had と現在完了

ja: もう少し弱い薬に変えてもらえませんか？
en: Could you switch me to a milder medicine?
alternatives: Could I get something a little milder?
Could you give me a milder medicine?
point: 「弱い」は weak でなく比較級 milder が自然

ja: 手がしびれる原因、わかりますか？
en: Do you know why my hands go numb?
alternatives: Do you know what's making my hands numb?
Do you know what's behind my numb hands?
point: why のあとは平叙文の語順で go numb

ja: この薬、処方薬と飲んでも大丈夫ですか？
en: Can I take this with my prescription?
alternatives: May I take this with my prescription?
Is this okay to take with my prescription?
point: 「処方薬」は my prescription と短く言える

ja: この薬を飲んでから、前より少し楽です。
en: I've felt a little better since taking this medicine.
alternatives: I've felt a little better since I started this.
I've been feeling somewhat better since taking this medicine.
point: since 以来ずっと続く状態は現在完了 I've felt で言う

ja: 先生、この痛みは自然に治まりますか？
en: Will this pain go away on its own?
alternatives: Will this pain clear up by itself?
Will the pain go away by itself?
point: 「自然に」は on its own / by itself

ja: 私たちが待っていたら、父は助からなかったかも。
en: If we'd waited, Dad might not have made it.
alternatives: If we had waited, my father might not have survived.
If we'd waited, my dad might not have pulled through.
point: 助かる は make it。過去の仮定は had+過去分詞

ja: 熱を下げるには、何をすればいいですか？
en: What should I do to lower my fever?
alternatives: How can I bring my fever down?
How do I get my fever down?
point: 「〜するには」は to 不定詞で目的を表す

ja: 兄は今日、病院で診てもらうんだ。
en: My brother is seeing a doctor today.
alternatives: My brother has a doctor's appointment today.
My brother's going to the doctor today.
point: 決まった予定は進行形 is seeing で表せる
